mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (3-month change) compresses equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen by at least 0.5% over the last 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 200 signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening that reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 200, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in labor force employment (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong economic growth, triggering equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 135000 and HOUST > 1400, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 360000), strong consumer demand and housing activity signal overheating, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 360000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) over the last 3 months indicates strong manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has risen by at least 0.5% over the last 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 4.5% indicates a tight labor market, associated with rising wage pressures and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a stagflationary regime, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and UNRATE > 4.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong manufacturing growth regime (INDPRO > 110), robust industrial production signals sustained economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 110, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
